scope: Uninterpreted source-interpretation/image/data-cut algebra. Injective truthful complete observation, independently qualified expected interpretation and interior stable-cut coordination are premises. Pre/post comparison under those premises excludes execution under a changed source; endpoint equality alone permits ABA. Data cuts may change without changing source interpretation. Not proved: completeness or injectivity of the selected native catalog census, native JSON/SQL/collation refinement, original installer/provider authentication, catalog/MVCC snapshot freshness, host buffering or transport behavior, dynamic external executable/fact routing, writer participation, graph mappings or backend admission.
